newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican state offers wheat financing for 300,000 T.
newsitem.headline: Mexican state offers wheat financing for 300,000 T.

text.p: Mexico's central Guanajuato state has pulled together 40 million pesos in finance to facilitate wheat purchases by millers for around 300,000 tonnes of grain, the state government said on Tuesday.
In a statement, Guanajuato said the financing aimed to free up wheat transactions between millers and farmers that had become static because of differences over price.
"Today we can say that we now have important financing to support the process of buying and selling of wheat," Guanajuato Governor Vicente Fox said, according to the statement.
Fox said the finance would be over four, six and eight month periods with low interest rates. The money comes 75 percent from federal funds and 25 percent from state coffers.
Guanajuato is likely to harvest 150,000 tonnes of wheat this cycle and the state has approximately 150,000 tonnes in store.

The governor said the intention was not to impose minimum floor prices for wheat in the state. But he added there were hopes that the financing would help farmers receive prices of at least 1,420 pesos per tonnes.
